title: Judge Gift Cards 2014: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."
"To examine the causes of life, we must first have recourse to death." —Mary Shelley, *Frankenstein*
"I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."
His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.
